name: CAME-Bench
description:
Dataset Card for CAME-Bench
	

CAME-Bench (Context-aware Agent Memory Evaluation Benchmark) is a synthetic dataset designed to evaluate agentic memory in continuous, goal-oriented trajectories characterized by high contextual interference.
🌐 Project Website: https://contextual-intent.github.io
📦 Project GitHub: https://github.com/Seattleyrz/contextual-intentThe main repo provides complete, clear instructions to run retriever methods on CAME-Bench.
For more information about the… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Seattleyrz/CAME-Bench.
reputation: A research-oriented synthetic benchmark for agentic memory and retriever evaluation with growing interest from the agent/memory research community.
